titulo_ja: ばかりか と だけでなく
titulo_es: Add a second feature with the

bloques.titulo: In addition, information is often presented as unexpected or more remarkable.
texto: It also adds elements and tends to be more neutral. The parallel form helps to follow what two things are related.
The restaurant is not only cheap, but also rich food.
(She does not only speak English; she can also speak French.)

frases.en: This restaurant is not only cheap; also, the food is rich.

frases.ja: かのじょ は えいご だけでなく、 フランスご も はなせます。
frases.es: Ella no solo habla inglés; también puede hablar francés.
frases.en: She does not only speak English; she can speak French.
